parsed.name: Cobolt激光器
parsed.description: Cobolt激光器是一种实验室激光光源，常用于光学搭建、样品激发、光路对准及其他需要稳定激光输出的实验。该类设备通常可通过串口通信进行控制与状态交互。
parsed.description_en: A Cobolt laser source is a laboratory laser used for optical setups, sample excitation, beam alignment, and other experiments that require stable laser output. This type of device is commonly controlled and queried through a serial communication interface.

actions.description: 检查与激光器的串口连接是否已打开
actions.description_en: Check whether the serial connection to the laser is open.

actions.description: 打开与激光器的串口连接
actions.description_en: Open the serial connection to the laser.

actions.description: 关闭与激光器的串口连接
actions.description_en: Close the serial connection to the laser.

actions.description: 清空与激光器串口通信的缓冲区
actions.description_en: Flush the serial communication buffers for the laser.

actions.description: 从激光器串口读取数据
actions.description_en: Read data from the laser over the serial interface.

actions.description: 向激光器串口写入数据或命令
actions.description_en: Write data or commands to the laser over the serial interface.
